name: Friendly Fire Maneuvers [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
You and your teammates can anticipate one another’s ranged attacks and stay out of each others’ way.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot.

Benefit(s): Allies cannot provide soft cover to enemies, allowing you to make attacks of opportunity against an enemy even if those allies grant you soft cover against that foe’s attacks. If an ally casts a spell that targets the area you are in as it allows a Reflex saving throw to avoid the effect (such as fireball), you gain a +4 dodge bonus on that saving throw.
